sig: [[["A", "Okay, everyone, before we get started, I'd like to introduce a new member of our team."], ["A", "This is Priya Sharma, who's joining us as our new engineering manager."], ["A", "Priya comes to us from Nexora, where she led a team of twenty developers for six years."], ["A", "She has a lot of experience with cloud infrastructure and mobile apps, which is exactly what we need right now."], ["A", "Starting next Monday, Priya will be in charge of both the backend team and the mobile team."], ["A", "So going forward, please send your weekly reports to her instead of me."], ["A", "I'll still be around, of course, but I'll be focusing on our new partnership projects."], ["A", "Priya would like to meet each of you individually over the next two weeks."], ["A", "She'll send out calendar invitations later today, so please accept one that works for you."], ["A", "Also, we're having a small welcome lunch for her this Friday at the Italian place across the street."], ["A", "Lunch is on the company, so I hope everyone can make it."], ["A", "Now, Priya, would you like to say a few words?"]], {"A": "M-US"}]
